scientific_integrity: The claims follow from an analytic proof and separately reproduced finite checks. Numerical experiments are not used as infinite proofs. Broad known non-subadditivity of ordinary Rényi entropy is not presented as new. The literature comparison is bounded, and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact entropy-order classification concerns strictly positive finite stationary laws and the reversible lazy-refresh kernel \(P=rI+(1-r)\mathbf1\pi^{\mathsf T}\), with \(0<r<1\). It does not concern arbitrary finite-state Markov chains or every truncated lag envelope.
title: A sharp order-one transition in the Rényi entropy of stationary Markov pairs
